connect.title: Connect to Tipeline
connect.intro: Your workflows run on your Tipeline Server. This app lets you run them and follow them from your phone.
connect.serverHint: The address you use in Desktop.
connect.mfaIntro: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app, or a backup code.
connect.missing: Fill in the server address, email and password.
connect.unreachable: Could not reach the server. Check the address and that this app's origin is allowed (TIPELINE_CORS_ORIGINS).

workflows.title: Workflows
workflows.empty: No workflows yet. Create them in Tipeline Desktop.

workflow.noOutputs: Finished. This workflow returns no outputs.
workflow.desktopOnlyInputHint: This input can't be filled in on a phone yet. The workflow uses its saved value.
workflow.lostConnection: The connection dropped during the run. It keeps going on the server.

assistant.title: Assistant
assistant.viewerOnly: The Assistant is for editors and admins. Ask an admin if you need it.
assistant.emptyIntro: Say it in your own words. The Assistant finds the workflow that does it and fills in what it can. Nothing runs until you press Run.
assistant.noDraftsHere: Writing a new workflow isn't available on the phone yet. You can ask for one in Tipeline Desktop.
assistant.remembered: You picked this one for a request like this before.
assistant.notInstalled: This workflow isn't installed yet. It's on the {hub} hub: install it from Tipeline Desktop, then ask again.
assistant.scheduleOnDesktop: You asked for it to run on its own ({schedule}). Schedules are set up in Tipeline Desktop for now, but you can run it once here.
assistant.paused: It carries on once someone approves it.
assistant.lost: The connection dropped during the run. It keeps going on the server.
